DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Exacerbated by possible insufficient intake)

The total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL indicates significant hyperbilirubinemia, yet the normal ultrasound rules out biliary atresia or surgical abdominal emergencies like appendicitis. Given her age, exclusive breastfeeding, and the exclusion of pathological causes, this clinical picture is consistent with breastfeeding jaundice, which results from caloric deficit. Are you able to increase her feeding frequency or supplement with formula to ensure adequate hydration?
